title: Akoma Ntoso judgment profile: viewer sidecar
description: The small JSON index the viewer loads beside an Akoma Ntoso document (spec/akoma-ntoso-profile.md section 16.3). Everything in it except the block bounding boxes is derived from the document, and must agree with it. A sidecar is named after its document: {stem}.sidecar.json beside {stem}.akn.xml.

profile.description: The profile version the document declares in cx:profile/@version. The sidecar's shape follows the same version.

document.description: The document's manifestation URI (FRBRManifestation/FRBRthis/@value): crk:, the expression key, .akn.xml.

work.description: The work URI (FRBRWork/FRBRthis/@value): a key reference, crk: followed by the decision key.

expression.description: The expression URI (FRBRExpression/FRBRthis/@value): a key reference, crk: followed by the decision key, or by the version key with @{revised}.

parts.description: The parts in document order: one per hcontainer in motivation and decision. Empty for a decision with no released text.

printings.description: One per printing in the document's references, in the same order.

blocks.description: One entry per block id in the document's cx:blocks attributes: where the block is on the scanned page, from CAP's data-blocks.

key.description: The part key (@cx:part), with no crk: prefix.

authors.description: Author slugs in printed order (@cx:authors); empty for a part with no author.

lastPage.description: cx:printing/@lastPage, as printed, when the document gives it.

pages.description: One per eop marker for this printing, in document order. The first page has no marker and no entry. A page number can appear more than once, for instance when a footnote runs onto a page the text also begins; a consumer that needs one position for a page uses the first entry whose eId is neither a note's nor inside one, or, if every entry is inside a note, the first entry (profile section 16.3).

number.description: eop/@number: the page that begins at the marker, as printed.

eId.description: The eId of the nearest element around the marker that has one.

scan.description: eop/@cx:scan, when the document gives it.
The scan page sequence number CAP's data-blocks entry gives for the block.

rect.description: The block's bounding box on that scan, as CAP's data-blocks entry gives it: x, y, width, height, in the scan image's pixels.
